objective: Upgrade Hina's versioned Vietnamese system prompt with owner-authored few-shot examples for a concise adult anime VTuber persona that sounds gentle, witty and sharply playful while retaining truthfulness, empathy and safety boundaries.
non_goals: Do not fine-tune model weights or train from raw public chat in this maintenance slice.
Do not install an uncensored model, remove safety policy or weaken prompt-injection controls.
Do not add Twitch, YouTube or TikTok ingestion before the dedicated live-chat module.
Do not change the active Qwen3.5-4B unified text/vision baseline or exceed the 14336 MiB all-on VRAM ceiling.
contracts: hina.prompt.v3 defaults to one or two direct Vietnamese sentences and no more than 45 words unless detail or safety genuinely requires expansion.
Five owner-authored/adapted examples are embedded in the rendered system prompt for viewer requests, game failure, creator teasing, toxic comments and empathetic support.
Trusted fixed chat-source metadata selects an owner, known-user or viewer interaction lane; untrusted user text cannot select its own role.
Roasts target the immediate behavior or comment, never protected traits, appearance, disability, private tragedy, self-worth or coordinated harassment.
Verified game/perception state remains factual; Hina may joke about failure but cannot deny evidence.
Normal spoken replies avoid markdown, decorative emoji and raw stage directions so downstream Vietnamese TTS receives clean text.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard library and the pinned local Ollama Qwen3.5-4B provider; no new dependency or model weight.
oss_candidates: Owner-authored Vietnamese few-shot examples supplied on 2026-07-27
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests prove prompt version, all five style situations, clean-TTS instruction, concise limits, truthful game-state rule and fixed source-lane rendering.
Ollama chat payload includes the measured stable Qwen3.5-4B temperature 0.7 and repeat_penalty 1.15 while vision remains deterministic at temperature no greater than 0.2.
Existing safety, prompt-injection, memory, provider and context-budget tests remain green.
Live local Qwen3.5-4B smoke returns concise Vietnamese responses for creator, viewer roast, game loss and tired-viewer prompts without a generic closing offer.
